Fixtures are documentation-derived reduced examples, not live test results.
- arxiv.xml: official API manual example hep-ex/0307015v1. Abstract shortened deliberately. https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html (retrieved 2026-09-25).
- scholar.json: official SerpApi organic-results documented structure, reduced to non-sensitive fields. Pagination URL has no API key. https://serpapi.com/google-scholar-organic-results (retrieved 2026-09-25).
- Other tests construct synthetic edge cases explicitly. They never run in production provider paths.
